title: Grateful Dead Live at Sacramento Memorial Auditorium on 1978-01-17
source: Source Info: Master Soundboard Reels > Cassette > Dat > CD > EAC > SHN (shnid 14555); This is a patched and re-mastered version of the shnid14555 soundboard source from Matt Vernon & JCotsman

ai_review.summary: Soundboard tape delivers a very good, pretty show highlighted by an outstanding Minglewood Blues.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the performance as a very good and surprisingly pretty set, with special love for the Minglewood Blues and Jerry Garcia’s inspired playing. The recording is described as a nice‑sounding board tape that captures the band clearly, with no reported technical flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers are favorable toward the music and the soundboard source; limited to two reviews but they provide clear positive comments, leading to a solid combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a 'nice tape' with clear board sound; no drop‑outs or muddiness mentioned. Reviewer prefers board over audience but finds both acceptable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; overall impression is that the show flows nicely and sounds pretty.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for an inspired, ‘Goddamn’ moment of playing.
